svg.text: Kiosk hardware: one per train car
Raspberry Pi 4 (or 5) + 7" touchscreen + WS2812B strip + dynamic NFC tag, on a power bank. Pins are physical header pins.
ST25DV16K at 0x53 / 0x57, or NTAG I2C plus 0x55
3.3 V only. The agent rewrites it per mission
port 2 → strip 5 V + GND via a USB pigtail, never the Pi's 5 V pin
budget: Pi ~1 A, screen ~0.5 A, LEDs ~0.5 A at brightness 0.4
One shared ground: Pi GND, shifter GND, strip GND and the power bank GND, or the data line won't work. Pi 4 + GPIO18: the agent runs as root (PWM uses /dev/mem) and dtparam=audio=off.
Agent: python -m questline_kiosk (systemd units in apps/kiosk-pi/systemd; --fake runs it on a laptop with fake LEDs and a fake tag). Full wiring table: docs/hardware.md
